'''Chris Chatelin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Lompoc tournament]] on 4 November 2000 with Gamorrean/Ortugg beats, according to Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1426">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-lompoc-ca-11-04-00d1426/ lompoc-ca-11-04-00], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 6 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-lompoc-ca-11-04-00d1426/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
